summary: <cite index="1-1">Geopolitical tensions jolted global markets Thursday, sending equities and bonds lower as oil jumped, reviving inflation concerns</cite> ahead of Friday's July jobs report. <cite index="1-5">The S&P 500 fell 0.2% on Thursday</cite>, while <cite index="1-9">the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 dropped 0.4%</cite>. <cite index="2-4">In after-hours trading, Airbnb jumped more than 8% after reporting stronger-than-expected revenue and earnings, while Cloudflare soared 16% on an upbeat full-year and current-quarter outlook</cite>. On the crypto front, <cite index="19-1,19-4">the crypto market slipped 0.5% as Bitcoin and Ethereum posted minor losses</cite>, with <cite index="19-10">Bitcoin trading at $64,373.79, down 0.25%</cite> and <cite index="19-15">the Fear & Greed Index improving from 25 (Extreme Fear) to 29 (Fear)</cite>. Markets are bracing for Friday's July nonfarm payrolls report, with <cite index="44-1">economists expecting a gain of just 83,000 jobs and an unchanged unemployment rate at 4.2%</cite>. <cite index="48-3,48-11">The U.S. war with Iran continues without any kind of agreement to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz</cite>, keeping energy prices elevated and rate-hike odds elevated following the Fed's late-July decision to hold rates steady at 3.5%-3.75%.

signals.title: Geopolitical tensions spike oil, lift inflation fears
signals.desc: Middle East conflict escalation sent oil prices higher Thursday, reviving inflation concerns and pushing stocks lower ahead of key jobs data.

signals.title: Airbnb and Cloudflare surge on earnings beats
signals.desc: After-hours trading saw Airbnb jump 8% and Cloudflare soar 16% on strong results, signaling pockets of resilience in tech earnings season.

signals.title: July jobs report expected to show weak payroll growth
signals.desc: Economists forecast only 83,000 jobs added in July, the weakest in months, which could signal labor market softening and complicate Fed policy.

signals.title: Crypto fear gauge improves despite minor Bitcoin losses
signals.desc: Bitcoin edged down 0.25% but the Fear & Greed Index rose to 29 from 25, suggesting easing panic even as markets consolidate.

signals.title: Hormuz Strait closure keeps energy prices elevated
signals.desc: Ongoing U.S.-Iran tensions with no deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz sustain oil price pressure, weighing on risk sentiment and rate expectations.

verdict: Markets await Friday's jobs report amid geopolitical volatility, weak payroll expectations, and elevated oil prices that cloud the Fed's path forward.
